$comment: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/workflow-src/lib/decide.js is the only place a decision is resolved. resolved_at binds each row to its decision sites.

hard_stops.when: A review or remediation fix would match a category of the Destructive Fix Gate per ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/safety-rails.md (Destructive Fix Gate).
A commit or push would land directly on the trunk branch instead of a working branch.
An injection scan flags external content as a suspected prompt injection attempt.
A run reaches the point where the overlord would recommend merging the pull request, and the user decides whether to merge.
A brood strain would start or proceed on work that requires the user to approve the strain first.
A plan declares an irreversible effect outside the repo, such as a deploy, publish, migration or write to an outside service, and the run reaches the plan's first wave.

rows.when: Cerebrate returns a plan with no open questions and the overlord decides whether to start implementing it.
A planner raises a decision in a plan or an analysis, either an open question or a choice among several viable options, and the overlord resolves it before proceeding.
A planner raises a decision while planning the remediation of review findings, such as which of several valid fixes to take, and the overlord resolves it before proceeding.
A worker or a reviewer escalates a blocker to the planner and the overlord decides where that escalation is routed.
Accumulated findings are detected as a root cluster and the overlord decides whether to route them to a zoomed-out planner pass.

A planner returns a remediation plan for review findings and the overlord decides whether to accept it and implement. The decision is asked when any flag of plan.remediation_gate is true: the Promotion Gate trips on accepting the plan, by any clause, as plan.remediation_gate.promotion_gate records, or the plan grows the surface, or it repeats a surface whose earlier fix did not close its class. It is taken otherwise.
The review loop detects diminishing returns and the overlord decides whether to stop remediating and exit the loop.
Any validate state fails and the overlord decides how to remediate before the run moves past validation.
The bump-type derivation yields a verdict and the overlord decides which version bump type to apply.
The bump-type derivation cannot determine a bump type from the commits and the overlord needs a decision.
The Trunk Freshness check at git preflight reports a non-zero count and the overlord decides how to proceed.
A commit lands after a gate held and the run goes back through every gate that ended on an earlier commit.
Route-workflow reports an ambiguous classification and the overlord cannot select a single handling workflow.
The overlord resumes a prior run or detects version skew in a run ledger and must decide whether to continue or restart.

A reviewer raises a question the review loop cannot settle alone, with its options and a recommendation. The script takes an agreed call that is reversible and not architectural, and the question user gate of the state machine still asks.

The reviewer would reject a high-severity review finding that no recorded decision covers, and the call decides whether the loop proceeds. The script takes an agreed call that is reversible and not architectural, and the question user gate of the state machine still asks.
